t: Introduction and overview — Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer
name: Introduction and overview — Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer
description: Introduction and overview of the Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's Type 45 Daring class — six ships — is among the world's most advanced air-defense destroyers, built around the Sea Viper (Aster) missile system and Sampson radar. The class provides fleet air defense for the Queen Elizabeth carriers. Power-system issues led to major refits in the 2020s. Baseline facts: Royal Navy air-defense destroyer; 6 built; Sea Viper/Aster system; carrier escort..

title: Comparison with contemporaries — Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer
description: Comparison with contemporaries of the Type 45 Daring-class Destroyer: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The Royal Navy's Type 45 Daring class — six ships — is among the world's most advanced air-defense destroyers, built around the Sea Viper (Aster) missile system and Sampson radar. The class provides fleet air defense for the Queen Elizabeth carriers. Power-system issues led to major refits in the 2020s. Baseline facts: Royal Navy air-defense destroyer; 6 built; Sea Viper/Aster system; carrier escort..
